rows.name: Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Mississippi physicians. Nine physician members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent (Miss. Code § 73-43-3).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Mississippi statute; MS publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Mississippi State Board of Education
rows.mandate: Governs Mississippi public education policy. Nine members — five appointed by the Governor, two each by the Lt. Governor and House Speaker (Miss. Const. § 202A).

rows.name: Board of Trustees of State Institutions of Higher Learning
rows.mandate: Governs Mississippi's eight public universities. Twelve members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — four from each Supreme Court district (Miss. Code § 37-101-1).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Mississippi statute; MS publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Mississippi Board of Nursing
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Mississippi's nurses. Thirteen members — twelve nurses appointed by the Governor from nominee lists plus one physician from the Board of Medical Licensure (Miss. Code § 73-15-9).

rows.name: Mississippi Commission on Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
rows.mandate: Sets policy for the Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks. Five members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent, one per historic congressional district (Miss. Code § 49-4-4).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Mississippi statute; MS publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Mississippi State Board of Pharmacy
rows.mandate: Licenses pharmacists and regulates drug distribution in Mississippi. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent (Miss. Code § 73-21-75).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Mississippi statute; MS publishes no central vacancy list (inventory mode)
